title: Scammers
body:
Ultiself charged me €55.08, then €34.45, and later another €55.58 without my knowledge. When I contacted support, they claimed they couldn’t help. Worse yet, after my complaint, they processed another charge to take even more money.

This company is a complete scam, only focused on squeezing money out of users. Stay far away!
author: Evanstien03

title: Not recommended
body: When you make it past the endless promotions, adverts and vids hyping up the app you finally see the actual screen presenting you with *the* custom set of habits that will improve your life. That’s where the disappointment starts. A set of tick boxes that let you indicate if you completed something. No explanation of the tasks set, nothing. What the app does have plenty of is ways to spend more dollars, lots of dollars. Despite the many often menial options to customise the list the overal experience is very disappointing.
author: RB-recentie

title: Waste of money and time
body:
Planer which have plenty in App Store cost here 30 euro early. 
Plus to that if you want to take any courses you need to pay 30-50 for one course. I am not granting that it will change your mind, health, or whatever you want to improve with subscriptions it’s not possible. My opinion 1 out of 10 totally waste of money and your time .

title: Not transparant
body: The ad and video on the landingpage seemed very promising and they claim that the app is free, but after downloading you have to pay. Also, you have to go through the questions again or login, while I have never received login details. This made me question the authenticity of the app. The video spoke of many positive reviews, which are not visible in the appstore. After Googling the reviews I learned that there are numerous problems with the functionality and user experience of the app, and also with payment, spamming on your emailadress and constant upselling. Therefore i deleted it again, disappointment!
author: Missteryguest
